subject.title: fix(telegram): prevent unmodified replies flashing in previews

question: Should Telegram suppress provider previews whenever either global modifier-capable outbound hook is registered, even if a particular hook may not modify every Telegram reply?
rationale: The patch is technically focused and proof-backed, but the safety-first gate intentionally changes the streaming-preview experience for existing hook-enabled deployments; repository policy treats fallback and behavior changes as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept conservative suppression
options.body: Merge the current Telegram-only gate so no potentially unmodified provider preview can appear before outbound modifiers.

options.title: Add hook applicability semantics
options.body: Keep previews for hooks that can prove they do not apply to the active Telegram delivery, which requires an explicit supported hook contract rather than an ad hoc Telegram exception.

options.title: Pause for shared-hook design
options.body: Defer this mitigation until the broader shared delivery contract has a maintainer-approved design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92374.

recommendation.title: Accept conservative suppression
recommendation.body: Merge the current Telegram-only gate so no potentially unmodified provider preview can appear before outbound modifiers.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the scoped implementation and its live Telegram proof; no independent current-main ownership trail could be inspected in this read-only environment.
